title: 10 Best Halloween Songs for Kids | SiriusXM
summary: Get ready to do the Monster Boogie with the cast of "Mickey Mouse Clubhouse" and much more.
body_markdown:
As spooky season draws near, so do the sounds of[Halloween](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/halloween-radio) — and SiriusXM’s[SCREAM Radio](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/scream-radio-siriusxm) .


Available now on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogKidsHalloweenMix) , the *Kids Halloween Mix* features some of the spookiest, kookiest, and grooviest Halloween songs for the whole family.


[Kids Halloween Mix Spooky, silly songs Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogKidsHalloweenMix)


Get ready to do the Monster Boogie with the cast of *Mickey Mouse Clubhouse* , dance under the sea with Ursula from *The Little Mermaid* , and cast a spell with the Sanderson Sisters from *Hocus Pocus* .


Before Halloween night brings frights, delights, tricks, and treats, check out 10 songs featured on the *Kids Halloween Mix* from SiriusXM’s[Kids Place (Ch. 134)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/kids-place) .


## 10 Halloween Songs for Kids


### 1. KIDZ BOP: “Spooky Scary Skeletons”


KIDZ BOP puts its own twist on the Andrew Gold Halloween classic, complete with a dance that will send shivers down your spine — and put a little boogie in your step.


### 2. Blippi and Meekah: “Party Like It’s Halloween”


Say what? Say boo! Blippi and Meekah are inviting you to their Halloween bash with the perfect tune to get little listeners on their feet and ready to catch a spooky beat before trick-or-treating.


### 3. Bette Midler, Sarah Jessica Parker, and Kathy Najimy: “The Witches Are Back”


The Sanderson Sisters returned to Salem 29 years after the original *Hocus Pocus* , bringing along a spooky song that reminds everyone what can happen when the Black Flame Candle is lit.


### 4. Riders in the Sky: “Monsters, Inc.”


Mike, Sulley, and Boo may bring plenty of scares, but this instrumental offers a playful break from the frights and adds a little delight to Halloween night.


### 5. Danny Weinkauf: “Halloween (The Night That I Love)”


It’s the spookiest night of the year, and Danny Weinkauf is ready to celebrate Halloween with his friends in this kid-friendly seasonal tune.


### 6. Melissa McCarthy: “Poor Unfortunate Souls”


Ursula delivers an eerie warning to Ariel in this memorable song from Disney’s *The Little Mermaid* , bringing just the right amount of under-the-sea fright to a Halloween playlist.


### 7. Citizens of Halloween: “This Is Halloween”


Jack Skellington, Oogie Boogie, and the residents of Halloween Town sing about the wonderfully frightening place they call home in the classic song from Tim Burton’s *The Nightmare Before Christmas* .


### 8. CoComelon: “Halloween Parade”


It’s time to show off those costumes. CoComelon provides the perfect soundtrack for little ones getting ready to march, dance, and celebrate in a Halloween parade.


### 9. *Mickey Mouse Clubhouse* Cast: “Monster Boogie”


Jam with Mickey and the gang as they show you how to boogie down monster-style in a song made for a Halloween dance-along.


### 10. KIDZ BOP: “Thriller”


KIDZ BOP puts a kid-friendly spin on Michael Jackson’s Halloween classic. There may be something lurking in the dark, but don’t be scared — get up and dance.


Hear Scream Radio’s Kids Halloween Mix on SiriusXM’s Kids Place (Ch. 134) starting October 22.
